summary: The shared side panel frame that slides in from the right, with a title bar, close button, scrolling body and optional footer.
purpose: Gives all drawers the same look and the same close behaviour.
why: Likely reason: one frame is reused by every drawer.
how: When open, shows a dimmed backdrop and the panel with its title and close button. The body scrolls, and a footer is shown if given. Clicking the backdrop or close button calls the close handler.
inputs: Open state, close handler, title, body content, and an optional footer.
risks: The panel stays in the page when closed and is only moved off screen, so hidden content may still be reachable by keyboard or screen reader. The close button is labelled as an evidence panel for every drawer.
debug: If the drawer does not appear, check the open state passed in. If it shows when it should not, check the same value.
